description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewaySession component of an Android application, specifically testing WebSocket interactions, token handling, and invoke request handling in a gateway communication scenario.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that stores tokens in memory for testing purposes.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class containing a GatewaySession, its Job, and an in-memory device auth store used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: Holds the request and response parameters of a node invoke scenario in tests.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests verifying the behavior of GatewaySession, WebSocket interactions, token handling, and invoke request processing.

methods.name: connect_usesBootstrapTokenWhenSharedAndDeviceTokensAreAbsent
methods.description: Verifies that the session uses the bootstrap token when no device or shared tokens are present.

methods.name: connect_prefersStoredDeviceTokenOverBootstrapToken
methods.description: Tests that the session prefers stored device tokens over bootstrap tokens during connection.

methods.name: connect_retriesWithStoredDeviceTokenAfterSharedTokenMismatch
methods.description: Ensures that after a token mismatch, the session retries with the stored device token.

methods.name: connect_storesPrimaryDeviceTokenFromSuccessfulSharedTokenConnect
methods.description: Checks that the primary device token from a successful shared token connection is stored correctly.

methods.name: bootstrapConnect_storesAdditionalBoundedDeviceTokensOnTrustedTransport
methods.description: Verifies that additional device tokens are stored when connecting via a bootstrap token on a trusted transport.

methods.name: nonBootstrapConnect_ignoresAdditionalBootstrapDeviceTokens
methods.description: Validates that additional bootstrap device tokens are ignored when not connecting with a bootstrap token.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_roundTripsInvokeResult
methods.description: Tests that a node invoke request round-trips correctly, with correct request and response data.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_usesParamsJsonWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks that the request uses paramsJSON when provided in the invoke event frame.

methods.name: nodeInvokeRequest_mapsCodePrefixedErrorsIntoInvokeResult
methods.description: Ensures that code-prefixed errors are correctly mapped into the invoke result error fields.

methods.name: refreshNodeCanvasCapability_sendsObjectParamsAndUpdatesScopedUrl
methods.description: Verifies that canvas capability refresh sends the correct object params and updates the current URL.

methods.name: testJson
methods.description: Creates a Json instance configured to ignore unknown keys.

methods.name: createNodeHarness
methods.description: Helper to create a test harness with a GatewaySession, Job, and device auth store.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Helper to initiate a connection of GatewaySession to a specified endpoint with tokens and options.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Waits for the session to connect or throws if timeout.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Cleans up the test harness by disconnecting session, canceling job, and shutting down server.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Sets up and runs an invoke request test scenario with WebSocket server callbacks.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string for WebSocket response frame with optional canvas URL and auth JSON.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Starts a mock WebSocket server with a custom dispatcher for test scenarios.
